tinlyn_benbyr_1.m: Is he still around? I thought the guards got the best of him.

tinlyn_benbyr_2.m: Anyway, I do not want to talk about that. I have left that kind of life behind me. Herding sheep is what I do now.

tinlyn_complete_1.m: Hello again. Thank you for helping me find my lost sheep.
r: I talked to Benbyr and heard the story about you two.
Your brother has sent me to ask where I could get fences from. Do you maybe know?

tinlyn_decline_1.m: Oh well, it didn't hurt to ask.

tinlyn_fence_1.m: Tunlon? So he's still alive after all. I haven't heard from him in years.
r: Yes. And he made me ask you if you knew where you could get fences from.

tinlyn_fence_1a.m: There is a woodcutter in Loneford. He should be able to help you out. Have a great day!

tinlyn_fence_2.m: [grumbles] Maybe I do. Go over to Loneford and leave me alone.

tinlyn_fence_2a.m: [grumbles] So Tunlon is still alive after all. I haven't heard from him in years. This Marauder. [grumbles]

tinlyn_found_1.m: Yes, I can hear distant sounds of bells from the fields to the south. I am sure they will come back here now that they have the bells on them.
r: That was some hard work. What about a reward?

tinlyn_found_2.m: I am sorry, but I am a simple shepherd. I have no wealth or magical trinkets to give you.

tinlyn_killedsheep_1.m: You attacked my sheep! Get away from me you filthy murderer!
r: I am sorry. But your brother sent me to ask if you knew where I could get fences for his sheep.

tinlyn_look_1.m: Hello again. Did you find all four of my missing sheep?
r: Yes, I found all of them.
Not yet. I am still looking.
What was I supposed to do?
I talked to Benbyr and heard the story about you two.

tinlyn_story_1.m: Hello there. You wouldn't happen to want to help an old shepherd would you?
r: Your brother has sent me to ask where I could get fences from. Do you maybe know?

tinlyn_story_2.m: You see, I tend my flock of sheep here. These fields are excellent pastures for them.

tinlyn_story_3.m: The thing is, I have lost four of them. Now I won't dare leave the ones I still have in my sight to go look for the lost ones.

tinlyn_story_4.m: Would you be willing to help me find them?
r: This doesn't sound like there will be any fighting involved. I only do things where there's fighting involved.
Absolutely, it would be my honor to assist you in locating your missing sheep.
What would I gain from this?

tinlyn_story_4_1.m: Gain? Why, my thanks of course.
r: This doesn't sound like there will be any fighting involved. I only do things where there's fighting involved.
Sure, I will help you find your sheep.
No thanks, I better not get involved in this.

tinlyn_story_5.m: Good, thank you. Please put these bells around their necks so I can hear them.

tinlyn_story_6.m: Return to me once you have placed bells around the neck of each of the four missing sheep.

benbyr.10: I have met Benbyr outside the Crossroads guardhouse. He wants to get revenge on an old 'business partner' of his - Tinlyn. Benbyr wants me to kill all Tinlyn's sheep.
benbyr.20: I have agreed to help Benbyr find Tinlyn's sheep and kill all eight of them. I should go look for them in the fields northwest of the Crossroads guardhouse.
benbyr.21: I have started attacking the sheep. I should return to Benbyr once I have killed all eight of them.
benbyr.30: Benbyr was thrilled to hear that all of Tinlyn's sheep are dead.
benbyr.60: I declined to help Benbyr kill the sheep.

tunlon_fence.10: I found Tunlon, a sheep farmer, on the hill next to Crossglen. He asked me to help him get some wood for new fences. Since Crossglen doesn't have a lumberjack, I should go to Fallhaven and ask there.
tunlon_fence.12: Tunlon got furious when he saw that I killed his sheep.
tunlon_fence.20: I talked to Fallhaven's woodcutter. He told me that he had done a lot of work lately and therefore can't get any more wood for me. However, I should ask the woodcutters near Crossroads Guardhouse if they can help me.
tunlon_fence.30: The woodcutters told me that they have a lot of wood after clearing out the field around them, however all they have is firewood. Apparently this is not suitable for making fences. I should explain this to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.32: Hadracor opened up a passage to the south, so I wouldn't have to take the long way up to Tunlon any more.
tunlon_fence.40: I talked to Tunlon again and he told me to talk to his brother Tinlyn if he knew any person who could help me out.
tunlon_fence.100: Tinlyn was glad to meet me. He said that Loneford had a woodcutter who could maybe help me out.
tunlon_fence.110: Tinlyn wasn't really happy to see me. However, he told me to go to Loneford.
tunlon_fence.150: In Loneford, I met a villager who told me he had some spare fences made. I should bring them to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.200: Tunlon took a close look at the fences I brought him, but he didn't like them a lot. The fence posts were too short he said. I should go back and ask for taller ones.
tunlon_fence.210: The woodcutter in Loneford however said he couldn't make any fences, as he just cuts the wood. He recommended giving Brimhaven's woodcutter a visit, as he thinks that he can do some basic woodwork.
tunlon_fence.220: I gave the woodcutter in Brimhaven a visit and he told me to bring some wood, so the craftsman can make fences out of it. Loneford's woodcutter should have plenty, so I should go back and ask him for wood.
tunlon_fence.230: I got a pile of wood for the fences.
tunlon_fence.235: I gave the wood to the woodcraftsman in Brimhaven.
tunlon_fence.240: Brimhaven's wood craftsman sold me some nice looking fences.
tunlon_fence.250: Tunlon was happy to see the fences I brought him. These should be just fine, he said.

tinlyn.10: On the road to Feygard, near the Feygard bridge, I met a shepherd named Tinlyn. Tinlyn told me that four of his sheep have wandered away and that he won't dare leave the remaining sheep to go look for them.
tinlyn.15: I have agreed to help Tinlyn find his four lost sheep.
tinlyn.20: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.21: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.22: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.23: I have found one of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.25: I have found all four of Tinlyn's lost sheep.
tinlyn.30: Tinlyn thanked me for finding his lost sheep.
tinlyn.31: Tinlyn thanked me for finding his lost sheep, but he had no reward to give me.
tinlyn.60: I have attacked at least one of Tinlyn's lost sheep and I am therefore unable to return them all to Tinlyn.
